items.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
items.summary: arXiv:2610.40747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy. We present Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid CUA trained from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint through an end-to-end, progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL. To power this curriculum at scale, Mage-CUA-Forge replaces per-task agent construction with reusable, skill-conditioned g
items.summary_zh: Mage-VL-Cowork 提出一种 4B 参数的混合型计算机使用智能体训练方案，通过五阶段课程学习实现 GUI 交互与代码终端执行的统一策略。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 训练范式领域，可学习如何通过多阶段课程学习（Curriculum Learning）将视觉感知与工具调用能力整合进单一模型。

items.title: The Generative Gap Between Speculative Drafter and Continuous Diffusion Language Model
items.summary: arXiv:2610.40847v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) and speculative drafters offer efficient language generation but are typically evaluated differently: CDLMs generate independently through iterative refinement, whereas drafters propose text for target-model verification and correction. We compare their architectures without verification, using LangFlow for CDLMs and adapting DSpark's Markov and recurrent-head architectures for standalone generation. All
items.summary_zh: 对比分析连续扩散语言模型 CDLM 与投机采样草稿模型在生成架构上的差异，探讨两者在无需验证机制下的生成性能与局限。
items.why_zh: 属于推理加速与生成模型架构领域，可学习评估不同生成范式（迭代细化 vs 投机采样）在特定任务下的效率与质量权衡。

items.title: ai-gateways/awesome-ai-gateways
items.summary: Awesome AI gateways: open source and commercial LLM gateways, MCP gateways, agent (A2A) gateways, model routers, specs, and guides.

items.title: AI agent swarms in Minecraft fail to build civilization, drown in bureaucracy

items.why_zh: 属于多智能体系统（MAS）领域，可学习如何设计更高效的协作协议与通信机制，避免复杂任务中的群体决策死锁。

items.summary_zh: 利用 Claude 自动化构建 HackerBooks 数据管道与网站，实现对 Hacker News 提及书籍的聚合与关联检索。
items.why_zh: 属于 AI 辅助开发（AI-native Dev）领域，可学习如何利用 LLM 驱动端到端的数据工程与全栈开发流程，提升原型构建效率。

items.title: wangzan101/Mika

items.title: NVIDIA Releases Auto Ontology: An Open Semantic Layer That Grounds AI Agent SQL
items.summary: NVIDIA released Auto Ontology, an Apache 2.0 library that generates a semantic layer from enterprise metadata. It grounds agent SQL in certified definitions and serves context through MCP, CLI and API. The post NVIDIA Releases Auto Ontology: An Open Semantic Layer That Grounds AI Agent SQL appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布 Auto Ontology 开源库，通过企业元数据生成语义层，利用 MCP 协议为 Agent 的 SQL 查询提供标准化定义。
items.why_zh: 属于 RAG 与 Agent 数据治理技能点，可学习如何通过语义层实现 Agent 对企业级数据库的精准查询与对齐。

items.title: Coinbase on OpenAI Private Intelligence
items.summary: For Coinbase, putting frontier AI to work starts with control over its data. Every employee has access to the latest OpenAI models. In this video, Rob Witoff explains why security, guardrails, and zero data retention are central to that trust. As he puts it: “It’s still our data.” OpenAI Private Intelligence gives businesses stronger controls over their data while using our most capable models. We’re building these protections with some of our largest customers to help businesses apply frontier …
items.summary_zh: Coinbase 采用 OpenAI Private Intelligence，在确保数据隐私、安全防护及零数据留存的前提下，为全员提供前沿模型访问权限。
items.why_zh: 企业级 AI 安全架构。掌握在生产环境中实施数据脱敏、访问控制及零留存策略，以满足高合规性业务需求。
